items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Henry Roy, Stonewall, Philip Nicholson, and uh, what's his name? ... I forgot his name already.

ctx.x: I'm asking who were some good guitar players before his time.

He said who were some good guitar players before your time? Well, Henry Martin, he was one of the first cups, was the best. Henry Roy, Stonewall, Philip Nicholson, and uh, what's his name? I can't think of his name. I had him landed my tongue. I forgot his name already. Oh yeah, no runs of stow. Yeah, he wasn't my tongue. No. Turn the toe. Yeah, he used to fire him and get me all the time.
Did any of those fellas play with their fingers, finger style, finger picking?
